dedupe_keys.name: dataset for senegal case study with onsset least cost electrification pathways for senegal by 2030 a nationwide analysis using open source spatial electrification tool onsset

description: Adama Sarr and colleagues publish model configuration and spatial results for a Senegal electrification study using OnSSET. Zenodo offers a CC BY 4.0 ZIP at no cost containing two described CSV files. One lists demographic, technology-cost, grid-extension and target assumptions; the other gives results for 58,701 settlement or grid-cell records for 2018, 2027 and 2030, including demand, technology choice, investment and levelised cost. These outputs can compare settlement-level grid-extension and off-grid capacity scenarios. A related first-review draft covers the general OnSSET model, while this separately published Senegal export is a specific input and result set. A limitation is that the deposit is not a complete OnSSET software release or self-contained replication package. Its technology costs and policy targets are study assumptions, not observed 2030 outcomes. No ZIP was downloaded or model run checked.
